checks.title: Site is at sea
checks.detail: The whole site is at sea.

checks.title: Outside the territorial sea
checks.reference: UNCLOS Art. 3; case study rule: Polish OWFs only in the EEZ

checks.title: Inside an energy basin of the maritime spatial plan
checks.detail: The whole site lies in energy basin PZP_44.
checks.reference: Polish maritime spatial plan, Dz.U. 2021 poz. 935; Act on the maritime areas, Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1125, Art. 23 ust. 1 and Art. 27g ust. 1 pkt 1

checks.title: Real wind farm projects
checks.detail: Already allocated to: Baltic II (350 MW, location permit (PSZW)); Baltica 9 (975 MW, location permit (PSZW)). Permits for this sea area are held by another developer — a real project would need their area or a new allocation.

checks.title: Natura 2000
checks.detail: A Natura 2000 site is 2.0 km away: screen for an appropriate assessment of effects on its conservation objectives.

checks.title: Clear of shipping routes
checks.detail: No shipping route crosses the site.

checks.title: Military areas and munitions
checks.detail: No military area or recorded munition dumpsite in the site. Unexploded ordnance can lie outside recorded sites: plan a UXO survey.

checks.title: Seabed sediment
checks.detail: Mixed sediment 40 %, Coarse-grained sediment 31 %, Sand 29 %, Mud to muddy sand 1 %. Mixed sediment: Gravel, sand and mud — in the Baltic often glacial till with boulders: boulder survey and clearance before piling. Boulders: pre-lay clearance (grab, plough) and more rock placement. A geotechnical survey decides.
checks.reference: EMODnet Geology seabed substrate 1:250 000; DNV-RP-C212 (piles), DNV-RP-0360 (cable burial)

checks.title: Ports
checks.detail: Nearest O&M port Ustka (under construction) 52 km by sea, CTV 1.4 h each way at 20 kn; nearest installation port Rønne (DK) (operating) 117 km by sea.
checks.reference: Port roles: operators' announcements; sea route on the EMODnet bathymetry grid

checks.title: Grid connection point
checks.detail: Krzemienica 400 kV (planned), 72 km straight from the site centre; the export route is longer. Not in full service yet — PSE investment: new 400 kV station Krzemienica (KZE), connection of the Bałtyk 1 offshore wind farm; permits obtained (inwestycje.pse.pl/stacjakrzemienica/). The farm's connection date follows PSE's schedule.

checks.title: Environmental impact assessment
checks.detail: Wind farms are an Annex II project: the competent authority screens whether an EIA is needed; large offshore wind farms in practice go through a full EIA.

checks.title: Indicative capacity
checks.detail: 113 km² usable × 4.5 MW/km² ≈ 508 MW (installed; spacing and layout decide the real figure).
